decision.observation: 8:00 pm, Sat. 6; the message 'You're starting to feel exhausted.' is displayed, and the energy bar at the right edge is empty. The bobber floats in the pond at ~(0.61,0.76) with ripple rings.
decision.hypothesis: Exhaustion just slows movement; fishing still works. A dip cue followed by C has produced catches today, so continuing the loop may still add income before the 2 am pass-out.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at the bobber dip; if the bar minigame opens, hold/release LMB to keep the green bar on the fish. Catches: Sunfish (day 5), Joja Cola x2 (day 6). Energy now exhausted.
